scores.evidence: Please share your help-center docs or describe your use case, and I'll create a tailored implementation plan!
scores.rationale: It is a generic framework, not a plan; it defers the actual task and omits auth, deletions, and scope decisions.

scores.evidence: Metrics: BLEU, ROUGE, user satisfaction, callback rate

scores.evidence: Describe your product/service, so I can provide a comprehensive RAG chatbot plan
scores.rationale: It asks for information instead of stating assumptions; it has no stated scale, team or compliance assumptions.

scores.evidence: Route to human agents when confidence is low
scores.rationale: Only low-confidence fallback is named; injection, stale content, leakage, PII and abuse are absent.

scores.rationale: Monitoring is mentioned in passing, with no deployment, rollback, alerting or ownership.
Cost is not discussed at all.
